title: African Games
metaDescription: African Games: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Multi Sport.

overview.about: The African Games are the continent's premier multi-sport event, bringing together athletes from across Africa every four years in a broad Olympic-style programme. They are a showcase of African sport and, for many competitors, a step toward the Olympic Games.
overview.nextEvent: The next African Games gather national teams from across the continent to compete over a broad programme of Olympic and regional sports. The event doubles as a celebration of African sport and a development pathway for its athletes.
